q1.question: Is Buildora free?
q1.answer: Yes. Free Build checks your resume against the job post, shows your ATS match score, adds missing keywords and lets you download the result as PDF or Word after you enter your email. The AI rewrite and the cover letter are paid: 50 birr for 1 day or 200 birr for 7 days.

q2.question: What is an ATS?
q2.answer: An applicant tracking system (ATS) is software employers use to collect and sort job applications. It reads your resume as plain text and lets recruiters search and filter by the skills and words in the job post. A resume that uses those words, in a simple layout, is easier to find.

q3.question: How do I pay with Telebirr?
q3.answer: Choose the 1-day or 7-day plan, send the exact amount with Telebirr to the number shown in the payment window, then enter the transaction number from your receipt. We check each payment by hand, usually within a few minutes, and your access starts when it is approved. Each transaction number works only once.

q4.question: Is my resume stored?
q4.answer: No. Free Build and file reading run inside your browser, so your file never leaves your device. If you use the paid AI Builder, your text is sent to our server only to create your result and is not kept afterwards. PDF and Word files are created on your device.

q5.question: Will the AI add experience I do not have?
q5.answer: It is told not to. The AI rewrites your resume and cover letter using only facts from your original resume, in the wording of the job post. AI can still make mistakes, so read the result before you send it, and remove any suggested skill you do not really have.
